pieces.Text: Your blood turns sluggish without sufficient heat, and you must seek warmth and shelter earlier than most. This oracle curse is common among lizardfolk and other oracles with the reptilian subtype. You take a -4 penalty on saves against cold spells and effects, and whenever you fail such a saving throw, you are staggered for 1 round. You can survive without food four times longer than a typical creature of your species before you begin to starve.

Poisons affecting you have their onset time doubled and last half as long if they end after a set time (for example, a poison with a frequency of 1/round for 6 rounds would instead have a frequency of 1/round for 3 rounds). Poisons with no onset time gain an onset time of 1 round.
Whenever an action you have readied is triggered, you can take an additional move action at half your speed-along with your readied action-even if you have already taken a move action that round.
You can take an additional move action
times per day. You can take these additional move actions only on your turn, and can take only one of these extra move actions per turn.
